title: LXR Hotels & Resorts Debuts in India with The Den Bengaluru
summary: Hilton today announced the opening of The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts, marking the debut of the award‑winning luxury brand in India.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Marking the brand's debut in India, the hotel joins LXR Hotels & Resorts’ handpicked collection of independent properties around the world, bringing LXR’s distinctive approach to personal discovery, restorative experiences and locally rooted hospitality to Whitefield


- **LXR Hotels & Resorts debuts in India with the opening of The Den Bengaluru, introducing Hilton’s collection of highly curated, bespoke luxury hotels to one of the country’s most important and internationally connected markets.**
- **Located in Whitefield, the 226-room hotel offers a contemporary expression of luxury shaped by its locale, alongside five dining and social venues, wellness and recreation facilities, and more than 21,000 square feet of event space.**
- **The hotel’s first phase of signature programming brings together ‘The Pause Program’ and ‘Whitefield Unscripted’, both of which offer experiences which are restorative and locally rooted.**


**BENGALURU, India –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the opening of[The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts,](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/blrolol-the-den-bengaluru/) marking the debut of the[award-winning](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/travel-leisure-2026-worlds-best-awards) luxury brand in India. Owned by Dan Hospitality India Pvt. Ltd. and managed by Hilton, The Den Bengaluru brings LXR Hotels & Resorts’ tailored approach to luxury to Whitefield, where heritage meets innovation, creative expression intersects with a global business hub, and vibrant urban energy coexists with a more relaxed rhythm.


The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts - King Executive Room


The 226-room hotel opens its doors as an LXR Hotels & Resorts and embraces the brand’s DNA with the launch of two signature programmes that bring its philosophy of personal discovery and sense of place to life. *The Pause Program* translates The Den’s *Pause in the Pulse* philosophy into thoughtful rituals woven throughout the guest journey, creating moments to slow down, reset and recharge. *Whitefield Unscripted* , inspired by LXR Hotels & Resorts’ Pursuit of Adventure, takes guests beyond the hotel to discover or rediscover the people, places and stories that give Whitefield its distinctive character.


-
-


The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Lobby Entrance (L) & Lobby (R)


Zubin Saxena, senior vice president and regional head, South Asia, Hilton, said, “India is one of Hilton’s most important growth markets, and the emerging expectations of the country’s luxury traveller are creating significant opportunity for brands that offer individual and experience-led stays. Bengaluru is a natural market for this next phase of growth as it is globally connected, culturally dynamic and home to a diverse community of travellers. As we continue to grow our luxury portfolio across the country, The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts adds a new dimension to the experiences we can offer travellers.”


The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts - The Creek


The hotel’s guest rooms, studios and suites couple intuitive technology with soothing interiors suited to business travel, leisure and extended stays. Dining spans four venues, including **Layla** , a rooftop restaurant with Indian and Mediterranean influences; **The Creek** , the hotel’s all-day dining multi-cuisine destination; **The Deli** , offering specialty coffee and artisanal pastries; and wellness-focused **The Cold Press,** a dedicated wellness counter offering cold-pressed juices, smoothies and nourishing refreshments.


The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts - The Sanctuary


At the heart of the hotel's wellness offering is The Sanctuary spa, where treatments are drawn from contemporary wellness practices and traditional healing philosophies. Guests can maintain their routines at The Studio fitness centre or unwind by the outdoor pool. Recreational spaces include The Playhouse, which features digital tabletop games and a pool table, and The Cave, an immersive screening experience designed to encourage informal socialising. For meetings, weddings and celebrations, the hotel offers more than 21,000 square feet of flexible event space across seven venues, ranging from a ballroom and auditorium to meeting rooms and an open-air amphitheatre.


The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts - The Poolside


“LXR Hotels & Resorts brings together a hand-selected collection of distinctive hotels in the world’s most alluring destinations,” said Dino Michael, senior vice president and category head, Hilton Luxury. "Each has its own story, character and point of view, offering guests a more intimate and unexpected way to experience the places they visit. With The Den Bengaluru, LXR makes its debut in India, bringing this spirit to a city with remarkable creative energy, cultural depth and cosmopolitan pulse. Rooted in Whitefield and connected to the wider rhythm of Bengaluru, the hotel invites guests to linger a little longer, look a little closer and discover something new. It is a fitting addition to a collection created for travelers who know the world well and still want to be surprised.”


Vinesh Gupta, general manager, The Den Bengaluru, LXR Hotels & Resorts, said,“We are proud to partner with Hilton and enter a new chapter with The Den Bengaluru as a part of LXR Hotels & Resorts. The hotel has always shared a close connection with Whitefield and joining LXR Hotels & Resorts allows us to build on that foundation through distinctive experiences and highly personalised service, complemented by the strength and reliability of Hilton Honors. With Hilton's global expertise and the unique spirit of LXR Hotels & Resorts, we look forward to welcoming guests from Bengaluru and around the world in new and meaningful ways.”


Through *The Pause Program* , restorative touches are woven throughout the stay, from a calming arrival experience and curated in-room amenities including a sleep well kit and pillow menu, to nourishing options at The Creek. *Whitefield Unscripted* offers immersive ways to experience the neighbourhood, including the Whitefield Verandah Trail, which explores heritage bungalows and longstanding local institutions, and Whitefield’s Farm Story, where guests can harvest produce at a local farm before enjoying a personalised meal created by the hotel’s culinary team.


The hotel is part of[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/) , the award-winning guest loyalty program for Hilton’s 28 distinct hotel brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including flexible Points and money payment options, exclusive member discounts and complimentary standard Wi-Fi. Members also enjoy popular digital tools available exclusively through the Hilton Honors mobile app, including digital check-in, room selection and Digital Key.


##### FAQ: LXR Hotels & Resorts Debuts in India with The Den Bengaluru


Its global connectivity, dynamic cultural and creative landscape, and diverse community of business and leisure travellers create strong demand for distinctive, experience-led luxury. Within the city, Whitefield’s blend of heritage, innovation and neighbourhood character offers a compelling setting for LXR’s destination-driven approach.


The hotel features 226 guest rooms, studios and suites, with intuitive technology and soothing interiors designed for business travel, leisure stays and extended visits.


The hotel offers five dining and social venues: Layla, a rooftop restaurant pairing Indian flavours with Mediterranean cuisine; The Creek, an all-day dining destination; The Nest, a social space for cocktails and curated programming; The Deli, serving specialty coffee and artisanal pastries; and the wellness focused The Cold Press.


Guests can experience The Pause Program and Whitefield Unscripted. Together, these two programmes bring complementary dimensions of the hotel to life: one creates moments of calm within the rhythm of the city, while the other invites those looking to discover or rediscover Whitefield to engage more closely with the neighbourhood’s heritage, culture and community.

## About LXR Hotels & Resorts


[LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/lxr-hotels/)


is a global collection of 18 luxury properties that celebrate the timeless pursuit of personal adventure. Found in the world's most alluring destinations, each hand-selected property boasts its own storied past and is infused with the essence of its distinctive locale, providing a luxurious hub for the discerning adventurer. As part of its commitment to enriching the guest experience, LXR Hotels & Resorts celebrates experiential travel with the Pursuit of Adventure, a brand signature that immerses guests in authentic, curated experiences that reflect the unique culture and character of each destination. LXR Hotels & Resorts is part of Hilton, a leading global hospitality company. Each property benefits from the strength of the Hilton enterprise and its award-winning[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/) program. Experience an inspiring stay at LXR Hotels & Resorts by booking at[lxrhotels.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/lxr-hotels/)


or through the industry-leading[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) .
